title: Market research app
author: Own_Maybe4510
selftext:
Hi everyone,  
I’ve developed a web app for market research and I wanted to see if this would be something that people would actually be interested in or if I’m wasting my time.  
The basics:  
Each day the App scans stocks, crypto, etfs and forex and then using data such as technicals, macro, news and fundamentals creates a score out of 100. Then the app provides the user with the top scored selection for each asset category.   
There are 3 research horizons - short, balanced and long.  
Currently implementing historical tracking   
Each selection is provided with a research explanation of what is happening with the asset including key risks in the opposite direction.

Keen to hear about what your thoughts are

The app is olbera.app if anyone is genuinely interested to have a look.
